name: RemoFirst
summary: RemoFirst hires and pays teams in 185+ countries and handles multi-country payroll, tax filings and pension contributions. Employer of record starts at $199 per employee per month with no annual contract, no minimums and no setup or termination fees.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: RemoFirst says the $199 fee may vary with local country requirements and that it gives a full cost breakdown before you commit.
RemoFirst's pricing page says it will do its best to match a better price found elsewhere.
Payroll can be invoiced in USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, NZD, SGD or ILS and summarized into one payment.
The EOR page and its FAQ give conflicting counts for visa-support countries and for support hours, so check both with the vendor.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Starting price, which can vary by country. No setup, onboarding or termination fees

hiddenCosts: RemoHealth insurance is an optional add-on starting at $55 per person per month.
Visa and immigration services are priced by location, visa category and employee status.
The $199 is a floor, and the fee may be higher in countries with extra requirements.

contract.cancellation: The FAQ says there are no annual contracts, no minimums and no termination fees.
